title: Luna the Little Spaceship and the Sleepy Star Garden
description: A little pearly-white spaceship and a tiny golden star visit a glowing Star Garden, watch the flowers fold for bedtime, and drift to sleep on a soft silver cloud.

Luna.color: Pearly-white body with soft sky-blue accents, top light, and pale-blue thruster glow
Luna.bodyShape: Small rounded spaceship with two short side fins, one curved windshield, two side windows, and a small rear thruster; no arms, hands, legs, or wheels
Luna.face: Exactly two friendly eyes in the windshield and a small gentle smile below
Luna.accessories: One small round sky-blue light on top; no writing, numbers, badges, or logos

Nib.role: Supporting character; a tiny golden star friend
Nib.color: Warm buttery-yellow with a gentle golden glow
Nib.bodyShape: Tiny five-pointed star with softly rounded tips, about one-quarter of Luna height; no arms, hands, legs, or clothing
Nib.face: Exactly two small dark brown eyes and one tiny curved smile

settingBible.Sleepy Star Garden: A floating silver-blue stardust island with pastel star-shaped flowers in pink, pale blue, and warm yellow, set in peaceful midnight-blue space with soft nebula clouds
settingBible.visualStyle: Warm polished 3D children's illustration, soft rounded shapes, dreamy cinematic lighting, one scene per page, and no readable text

continuityRules: Luna stays pearly-white with sky-blue accents, two windshield eyes, a small smile, two fins, and one top light.
Nib stays a smaller five-pointed golden star with two eyes and a smile, and first appears on page 5.
No rescue, repair, danger, chase, or frightening scenes.
Star flowers and background stars have no faces.
Brightness softens toward bedtime on the later pages.
Every illustration is one continuous scene with no panels, collage, grid, text, badge, logo, or readable words.

pages.text: In the quiet evening, far above the sleeping Earth, a little spaceship named Luna floated among the stars.
pages.illustrationScene: Luna the little pearly-white spaceship floats far above sleeping Earth among soft stars.
pages.continuityNotes: Lock Luna: pearly white, sky-blue accents, two windshield eyes, small smile, two fins, top light. Nib absent.

pages.text: Luna's soft blue lights twinkled as she watched the quiet universe.
pages.illustrationScene: Luna's soft blue lights twinkle as she watches the quiet midnight-blue universe.
pages.continuityNotes: Luna alone; soft blue lights twinkle. No Nib.

pages.text: Tonight, Luna wanted to visit the beautiful Star Garden beyond the moon.
pages.illustrationScene: Luna turns toward the path beyond the moon, ready to visit the Star Garden.
pages.continuityNotes: Luna alone looking toward the garden path beyond the moon.

pages.text: She glided past the silver moon, where sleepy craters rested in the moonlight.
pages.illustrationScene: Luna glides past a silver moon with soft rounded craters in gentle moonlight.
pages.continuityNotes: Luna alone past silver moon. Nib still absent.

pages.text: A tiny golden star named Nib floated nearby and gave Luna a cheerful wink.
pages.illustrationScene: Tiny golden five-pointed star Nib floats near Luna and gives a cheerful wink.
pages.continuityNotes: Introduce Nib: tiny golden five-pointed star, two eyes, smile, about one-quarter Luna's height.

pages.text: "Come see the Star Garden," whispered Nib, drifting gently ahead.
pages.illustrationScene: Nib drifts gently ahead while Luna follows, invited to see the Star Garden.
pages.continuityNotes: Nib leads gently; Luna follows. No danger.

pages.text: Together, they followed a sparkling trail of stardust through the peaceful sky.
pages.illustrationScene: Luna and Nib follow a sparkling stardust trail through the peaceful sky together.

pages.text: Soon, they reached a little floating garden filled with glowing star-shaped flowers.
pages.illustrationScene: They arrive at a floating garden island filled with glowing star-shaped flowers.
pages.continuityNotes: Arrive at floating Star Garden with glowing star flowers.

pages.text: The flowers swayed softly, but they still shone pink, blue, and warm golden yellow.
pages.illustrationScene: Pink, blue, and warm golden star flowers sway softly in the floating garden.
pages.continuityNotes: Pastel pink, blue, and warm yellow flowers sway. No faces on flowers.

pages.text: Luna hovered beside a fluffy cloud of stardust while Nib floated among the flowers.
pages.illustrationScene: Luna hovers by a fluffy stardust cloud while Nib floats among the flowers.
pages.continuityNotes: Luna by stardust cloud; Nib among flowers.

pages.text: One by one, the star flowers folded their glowing petals for bedtime.
pages.illustrationScene: One by one the star flowers fold their glowing petals for bedtime.
pages.continuityNotes: Flowers fold petals for bedtime. Lights begin to soften.

pages.text: Nib gave a tiny sleepy yawn, and Luna dimmed her gentle blue lights.
pages.illustrationScene: Nib yawns sleepily as Luna dims her gentle blue lights in the garden.
pages.continuityNotes: Nib yawns; Luna dims blue lights.

pages.text: They watched the distant Earth sparkle like a little blue marble.
pages.illustrationScene: From the garden overlook, Luna and Nib watch distant Earth sparkle like a blue marble.
pages.continuityNotes: Distant Earth as small blue-and-white sphere.

pages.text: Luna settled onto a soft silver cloud, with Nib resting close beside her.
pages.illustrationScene: Luna settles on a soft silver cloud with Nib resting close beside her.
pages.continuityNotes: Both rest on soft silver cloud.

pages.text: And beneath a blanket of twinkling stars, Luna and Nib drifted peacefully to sleep.
pages.illustrationScene: Luna and Nib sleep peacefully on the silver cloud under a blanket of twinkling stars.
pages.continuityNotes: Both asleep; dim garden glow; peaceful goodnight ending.
